title: Concept: Gemfile.lock dependency lockfile served
description: A lockfile is a version inventory with no ambiguity. It tells the caller exactly which gem versions are deployed, which is the input any exploit selection needs, and it names the private gem source.
applicability: Responses from a Ruby deployment that ships the repository root.
risk: The caller obtains an exact dependency inventory and the private gem source, then selects a matching known issue.
